items.evidence: Log shows 48 separate p1000 pick-up/drop cycles, each aspirating 250 uL from a distinct tube (slot 10 then slot 7) into a distinct well A1..H11 odd columns; eluates go to the same column positions on the elution plate.

Log order is beads 40 uL (lines 14-25), isopropanol 2x125 uL (28-51), then sample 250 uL with 5x300 uL mix per tip; delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, then 3x180 uL (540 uL) removed per column to waste plate slot 1 with the magnet on.
Two washes of 3x166.667 uL (500 uL) ethanol from A9/A10 and A11/A12, each removed to the waste plate with magnet engaged (lines 815-947), then delay 240 s and disengage (948-949) before elution.
After disengage, 100 uL from A4 added with a 10x80 uL mix per column (951-1093), delay 30 s, engage, delay 90 s, then 80 uL moved to A1..A11 of the elution plate on the tempdeck set to 4 C at line 2.

Step order matches the paper and task, with 70% ethanol and correct reagent columns, and comments match the actions. The only extra is a 5x150 uL bead pre-mix in the reservoir, which is minor and does not alter the workflow.

judge.summary: The simulated run log matches the task steps: volumes, order, tip handling, magnet states and delays are all correct for 48 samples. The only deviation is a small bead pre-mix in the reservoir, which I did not count as an invented step.
